requirements_why.text: The task description was clear with detailed acceptance criteria, technical details, and files to create/modify. The ancestor epic provided additional context about the print workflow friction.

steering_why.text: The planning brief provided sufficient context about the codebase structure and the existing print/dashboard patterns to create a solid implementation plan.

scope_why.text: The task is well-scoped as a single vertical slice (view + template + URL + button) with clear boundaries. It builds on existing print templates and dashboard patterns.
